title: Existence and uniqueness of the strict evaluation comparison
statement: Use the strict tensor, Hom, generators and normalization of [def-sfb-internal-hom-strict-models]. For every pair of cochain complexes P,L, there is a unique natural transformation a:tensorFixed(homFixed(P)(L)) -> tensorFixed(I_R(L)) followed by homFixed(P), satisfying Normalized(a). This is the unchanged original comparison_existsUnique assertion.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.12 and Proposition 6.8.14 (continuity and coefficient passage), Remark 6.8.15 (ambient operations); conditional ring-sheaf comparison is an agent formulation of the argument extracted from returned step 8, not a verbatim assertion of the source.

proof.text: Send t tensor f to the cochain x maps to t tensor f(x), followed by eta. Balancedness gives a sheaf morphism; the Hom and total differentials agree because t has degree zero. The formula commutes with all coefficient maps. Sheafified pure tensors and Hom-product projections detect equality, proving uniqueness.

lean.statement:
theorem comparison_existsUnique (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v r})
    (P L : CochainComplex (Modules.{u, v, r} J R) ℤ) :
    ∃! a : tensorFixed.{u, v, r} J R ((homFixed.{u, v, r} J R P).obj L) ⟶
      tensorFixed.{u, v, r} J R ((coefficientHomResolution.{r, u, v} J R).obj L) ⋙
        homFixed.{u, v, r} J R P,
      Normalized.{u, v, r} J R P L a
